question:
In figure, ∠ADB is equal to: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/015e8e4c9475a69a4a358aaaf4c9a1b3563fb59556b87b7e0b63d56fd382105d.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the **Circle Geometry Theorem**, angles subtended by the same **arc** at the **circumference** (in the same **segment**) are always equal.

From the given **figure**, ∠ACB and ∠ADB are subtended by the same **arc AB**.

Given: ∠ACB = 80°ree;

∴ ∠ADB = ∠ACB = 80°ree;.

**∴ The correct answer is 80°ree;.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Points **A, B, C,** and **D** lie on the circumference of the **circle**.

∠ACB = 80°ree;.

**Theorem Used:**

The **angles** in the same **segment** of a **circle** are equal to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40e694953a3e9768e46f1245563a1b0ac4c8fe4616342528820074864c0f5dc3.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Arc **AB** subtends ∠ACB and ∠ADB on the major **segment** of the **circle**.

⇒ By the property of **angles in the same segment**:

⇒ ∠ADB = ∠ACB

⇒ Given that ∠ACB = 80°ree;

⇒ ∴ ∠ADB = 80°ree;

**∴ The correct answer is 80°ree;.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle at Center Theorem

The **angle** subtended by an **arc** at the **center** of a **circle** is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the **circle** (∠AOB = 2 × ∠ACB).

Angle in a Semicircle

The **angle** subtended by a **diameter** at the **circumference** is always a **right angle** (90°ree;).

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

In a **cyclic quadrilateral** (where all four vertices lie on the **circle**), the sum of the **opposite angles** is 180°ree; (∠A + ∠C = 180°ree; and ∠B + ∠D = 180°ree;).</p
